description: Translate a natural-language property-search sentence into a structured filter payload compatible with search_listings. Use this as a transparent intermediate step: pass the user's raw query here, then forward the returned filters — and the returned bounds, when present (they carry the "near <place>" intent) — to search_listings.

prompt.description: A natural-language property search sentence from the end user. Example: "industrial with rail access in Denver under $5m".

name: interpret_search
title: Interpret search query
